title: Reentrancy (SWC-107)
text: Reentrancy: an external call (call/transfer/send or a token hook) is made before state is updated, letting the callee re-enter and repeat the effect. Fix: checks-effects-interactions, update state before external calls, or a nonReentrant guard. Smell: msg.sender.call{value:..}() before balances are zeroed; ERC777/ERC721 hooks.

title: Access control / missing authorization
text: State-changing or privileged functions (setOwner, upgrade, mint, withdraw-all, pause, setConfig) lacking an owner/role modifier or using tx.origin. Fix: onlyOwner/role checks with msg.sender. Smell: public/external mutators with no modifier; initializer callable twice.

title: Oracle manipulation
text: Price read from a spot source (AMM reserves, single-block) or a stale oracle without staleness/deviation checks can be manipulated with a flash loan to mis-price collateral, mint, or liquidate. Fix: TWAP, Chainlink with heartbeat+answeredInRound checks, deviation bounds.

title: Arithmetic / precision
text: Unchecked over/underflow (unchecked blocks, <0.8, casts), rounding that favors the attacker, division-before-multiplication, share-inflation on first deposit in vaults (ERC4626). Fix: checked math, round against the user, seed shares.

title: Unsafe delegatecall / proxy
text: delegatecall to attacker-influenced address executes code in this storage context; uninitialized proxy implementations can be self-destructed or reinitialized; storage-slot collisions between proxy and implementation. Fix: fixed trusted targets, initializer guards, EIP-1967 slots, disable implementation init.

title: Signature replay / EIP-712
text: Signatures reused across chains (no chainId), across contracts (no verifying contract / domain separator), or without a nonce; ecrecover(0) returning address(0); malleable s. Fix: EIP-712 domain with chainId, per-user nonce, reject v/s malleability.

title: Flash-loan economic attack
text: Atomic flash-borrowed liquidity distorts an assumption read mid-transaction (price, totalSupply, voting power) to bypass solvency or governance. Fix: don't trust same-block spot state; snapshot/averaged values; guard governance with time.

title: Cross-function / state interaction
text: Two individually-correct functions share mutable state so an A-then-B or interleaved sequence breaks an invariant (accounting, solvency). Found by: functions whose written storage overlaps another's reads; invariant fuzzing across the whole contract.

title: Unchecked low-level call return
text: call/send/delegatecall return value ignored, so a failed transfer is treated as success, corrupting accounting. Fix: check the boolean return or use SafeERC20; beware tokens that return no bool.

title: Weak randomness
text: block.timestamp/blockhash/number/prevrandao used for randomness are predictable or miner-influenceable. Fix: commit-reveal or a VRF.

title: Bridge / cross-domain
text: Cross-chain message verification flaws: forged proofs, replay across domains, missing finality, trusting an unauthenticated relayer, or mismatched source/destination accounting. Fix: verify message origin + nonce + finality; strict replay protection.

title: Governance / timelock
text: Governance attacks: flash-borrowed or delegated voting power, missing timelock on execution, proposal threshold too low, or privileged config/implementation changes applied without delay. Fix: snapshot voting at proposal, enforce timelock, bound admin power.
